items.title: Surgical smoke exposure in operating rooms: Health risks, occupational protection and emerging smoke evacuation technologies
items.body:
-We are preparing a review article titled "Surgical Smoke Exposure in Operating Rooms: Health Risks, Occupational Protection and Emerging Smoke Evacuation Technologies"
-Target journal: Indian Journal of Anaesthesia (Review Article)
-The draft covers smoke composition, health risks to operating room staff, protection measures and new smoke evacuation technologies, with recommendations for Indian hospitals
-We are inviting anaesthesiologists, surgeons, OT technologists and perioperative nurses to join as co-authors
Co-authors will help with critical review, Indian clinical perspective, and an optional short survey of smoke-safety practices in their own operating rooms
-Authorship will follow ICMJE criteria, and every co-author must contribute meaningfully and approve the final version
-To take part, send your name, designation, institution, ORCID iD and a brief note on how you would like to contribute

items.title: Co-authors wanted: Clonidine vs Tramadol in supraclavicular brachial plexus block
items.body:
We are inviting co-authors for a comparative clinical study of clonidine and tramadol as adjuvants to local anaesthetics in supraclavicular brachial plexus block.

- Author positions open: 2
- Last date to apply: 5 October 2026
